outcome: length of stay (LOS) in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs)
cohort: The study included 915 neonates (53.6% males, 46.4% females) admitted to the NICU of King Saud Hospital in Unaizah, Qassim region, Saudi Arabia.
finding: Cesarean delivery, preterm delivery, low birth weight, and RDW were positively associated with longer NICU length of stay, while neonatal jaundice and WBC count were negatively associated.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was found to be positively associated with an increased neonatal intensive care unit length of stay (aRR = 1.38, 95% CI = 1.30-1.47).
